label: TP
reason: User input is directly incorporated into a data attribute without full HTML entity encoding. While double quotes are escaped with ", other dangerous characters (e.g., <, >, ') remain unencoded, allowing potential XSS payloads like '<script>alert(1)</script>' to be injected into the DOM via the data-name attribute.

evidence.note: Unsanitized user input flows directly into HTML attribute value with partial encoding
